einzeiler: Discussing Dungeon Crawler Carl chapters 22 through 26 of A Parade of Horribles.
kurzfassung: The hosts review chapters 22 through 26 of A Parade of Horribles, covering the aftermath of the second race and preparations for heat three. Carl deals with the bizarre complications of his kangaroo suit while navigating new system announcements and character updates. The episode also features fan comments, convention announcements, and comedic sponsor roll call antics.
stichpunkte: Reviewing chapters 22 through 26 of A Parade of Horribles with the Dungeon Crawler Carl podcast team.
Carl copes with wearing an unsettling, wired kangaroo suit that has integrated into his nervous system.
The hosts announce upcoming convention appearances, including a guest spot at Cape Con in Missouri.
System announcements reveal brutal developments and hints about the upcoming eleventh floor.
Discussion of various character plotlines, including Dong's mysterious ailment and Samantha's unexpected driving skills.
Analyzing fan theories regarding the AI's true nature, hidden loopholes, and potential escape routes like the Pineapple Cabaret.
Closing out the episode with custom listener death watch scenarios and patron acknowledgments.

clips.text: The hosts discuss the horrifying realization that Carl's kangaroo costume has wired itself directly into his nervous and digestive systems.

clips.hook: A fast and brutal eleventh floor
clips.text: The speakers analyze the implications of the AI's statement that the upcoming eleventh floor will be handled very quickly.

beschreibung:
Welcome back to our Dungeon Crawler Carl Read-along! It is time for us to continue our journey with book 8 of the series: 'A Parade of Horribles'! Join us!
We are examining this through the experience of listening to the audiobook and would encourage you to as well if you can. We welcome your feedback and comments (no spoilers, please!) as we go through this so please hit us up in the comments!
